beats.label: S1 · Rachel finds Dick
beats.text: Detroit cop Dick Grayson takes in teen Rachel Roth after her mother is murdered and dark powers surface; a hidden second self kills her would-be sacrificer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the pairing that anchors every season.

beats.label: S1 · A team of four
beats.text: Amnesiac Kory Anders tracks Rachel across continents believing she must kill the girl; instead she and Dick form a makeshift team with Rachel and shape-shifter Gar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the founding four Titans and Kory's original directive.

beats.label: S1 · The new Robin
beats.text: Bruce Wayne's new Robin, Jason Todd, arrives to rescue Dick from a strike team; Dick is shaken by Jason's brutality and burns his own Robin suit for good.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jason and pushes Dick out of the Robin identity that defined him.

beats.label: S1 · Rachel's father
beats.text: On Kory's ship the team learns Rachel's father is Trigon, a world-devouring demon, and that Rachel is his doorway to Earth — and possibly the way to destroy him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season's stakes and Rachel's dual role.

beats.label: S1 · Angela's betrayal
beats.text: Rachel's mother Angela is exposed as Trigon's willing partner; she poisons Gar to force Rachel to summon Trigon, who heals Gar and waits for Rachel's heart to break.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Trigon arrives on Earth, the mother figure is unmasked, and the finale is set.

beats.label: S1 · Dick corrupted
beats.text: Only Dick passes Trigon's barrier — and Trigon traps him in a dark future where he murders Batman, breaking him into an enslaved servant of Trigon's will.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Directly sets up the season-ending status of the protagonist.

beats.label: S1 · Cadmus escapee
beats.text: In Metropolis, a young man with a Superman-logo tattoo escapes a Cadmus lab and frees a dog with red-glowing eyes, unnoticed by the trapped Titans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the character who becomes central to the next season.

cliffhanger.text: Rachel is under Trigon's control after Dick's dark vision broke her heart, and Dick himself has been enslaved by the demon. Only Gar, revived by Trigon, still stands with them inside a house sealed off from the rest of the team.
questions: Can the enslaved Dick be pulled back from Trigon's grip?
Will Rachel find the will to fight her own father?
Who is the Cadmus escapee bearing Superman's mark?

characters.name: Dick Grayson
characters.line: Bruce Wayne's first ward, a Detroit cop by day and vigilante Robin by night — until he burned the suit and was broken by Trigon's dark future.

characters.name: Rachel Roth
characters.line: Trigon's half-human daughter with dark telekinetic powers; her broken heart has just delivered the world to her father.

characters.name: Kory Anders (Koriand'r)
characters.line: A Tamaranean warrior sent to kill Rachel; recovered her memory and chose to protect her instead.

characters.name: Garfield 'Gar' Logan
characters.line: A green shape-shifting teen from the Doom Patrol; poisoned to death and resurrected by Trigon himself.

characters.name: Jason Todd
characters.line: Bruce Wayne's second Robin — brash and violent, unwelcome company for Dick.

characters.name: Angela Azarath
characters.line: Rachel's mother, revealed as Trigon's willing consort who engineered his return to Earth.

characters.name: Hank Hall (Hawk)
characters.line: A childhood-abuse survivor and street vigilante; helped Dick in years past and is now Dawn's partner.

characters.name: Dawn Granger (Dove)
characters.line: Hank's partner in life and in the field; recently awoke from a Nuclear Family–induced coma.

characters.name: Donna Troy
characters.line: Dick's Amazon-trained old friend who translated Kory's mission and helped him find her.

characters.name: Conner (Subject 13)
characters.line: A man bearing a Superman logo tattoo who has just escaped Cadmus with a red-eyed Labrador at his side.

beats.label: S2 · Titans reborn
beats.text: The team frees Rachel from Trigon and she banishes her father; Bruce Wayne gives Dick permission to rebuild the Titans in San Francisco with Jason on the roster.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves S1 and sets up the season's team and home base.

beats.label: S2 · Deathstroke returns
beats.text: Deathstroke resurfaces to punish the Titans and his daughter Rose defects to them; a flashback reveals Dick got Deathstroke's son Jericho killed years ago.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the antagonist and the buried secret that will fracture the team.

beats.label: S2 · Conner arrives
beats.text: Cadmus escapee Conner, a Superman-Luthor hybrid, appears when he and Krypto save a falling Jason; kryptonite nearly kills him before Kory revives him with sunlight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Conner properly and joins him to the team.

beats.label: S2 · Team fractures
beats.text: Deathstroke's revenge forces Jericho's death into the open; the guilt scatters the team, and Dick has himself imprisoned to keep Deathstroke away from his friends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the Titans dissolve mid-season and Dick vanishes.

beats.label: S2 · Cadmus and Blackfire
beats.text: Cadmus captures Gar and Conner and brainwashes them into weapons; Kory learns her sister Blackfire took Tamaran's throne by murdering their parents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets both the season's climax fight and Kory's future arc.

beats.label: S2 · Rose kills her father
beats.text: Rose kills Deathstroke and Jericho's soul leaps into her body; the Titans free Gar and Conner, but Donna dies saving civilians from a falling tower.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves Deathstroke, saves Jericho, and takes Donna off the board.

beats.label: S2 · Nightwing rises
beats.text: Dick emerges as Nightwing with a new team; Rachel takes Donna's body to Themyscira and Jason departs alone, as Blackfire arrives on Earth in a stolen body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in Dick's new identity and the pieces the next season inherits.

cliffhanger.text: Dick has taken up Nightwing and formed a new team, but Rachel is on Themyscira trying to raise Donna, Jason has gone off alone, and Blackfire has just seized a human host on Earth.
questions: Can Rachel bring Donna back through Amazon magic?
What does Blackfire want on Earth?
Where has Jason gone, and who is he becoming?

characters.name: Dick Grayson (Nightwing)
characters.line: Founding leader who confessed to causing Jericho's death; has taken up the Nightwing identity and rebuilt the team.

characters.name: Kory Anders
characters.line: Fully aware of her Tamaranean identity again; hunted by her queen sister Blackfire back home.

characters.name: Rachel Roth
characters.line: Powers still volatile; has just left for Themyscira carrying Donna's body.

characters.name: Garfield 'Gar' Logan
characters.line: Freed from Cadmus's brainwashing; the only member who stayed with Dick when everyone else left.

characters.name: Jason Todd
characters.line: Broken by Deathstroke's torment and the discovery that Dick was Jericho's killer; has quit the team and gone dark.

characters.name: Conner
characters.line: Deprogrammed from Cadmus and joined the new Titans; still learning to control his Superman and Luthor sides.

characters.name: Rose Wilson
characters.line: Killed her own father Deathstroke; now shares her body with Jericho's soul.

characters.name: Donna Troy
characters.line: Killed in the finale saving civilians; her body is with Rachel on Themyscira.

characters.name: Blackfire (Komand'r)
characters.line: Kory's sister and queen of Tamaran; just arrived on Earth in a stolen human body.

characters.name: Hank Hall & Dawn Granger
characters.line: Retired vigilantes; broke up after Hank concluded the Titans hurt everyone around them.

beats.label: S3 · Jason is dead
beats.text: Word reaches Dick that the Joker has killed Jason; he returns to Gotham where Bruce has just murdered the Joker in retaliation and left the city in Dick's hands.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the season's location, mission, and Bruce's absence.

beats.label: S3 · Red Hood
beats.text: A hooded figure extorts Gotham's mobs; the Titans track him to a warehouse and unmask a still-alive Jason as Red Hood, working with Jonathan Crane.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season's antagonist pairing and Jason's new face.

beats.label: S3 · Hank dies
beats.text: Jason plants a bomb in Hank's chest and manipulates Dawn into pulling a trigger that detonates it, killing Hank as Conner arrives too late to defuse it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Hank permanently and marks Jason as a real killer of family.

beats.label: S3 · Lazarus origin
beats.text: Crane resurrected Jason in a Lazarus Pit and hooked him on a fear-eliminating drug; Crane now plans to flood Gotham's water with a mass fear toxin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Jason's return and locks in the season's endgame.

beats.label: S3 · Kory and Blackfire
beats.text: Kory frees her sister Blackfire, who absorbs her flame; a vision reveals Kory's powers were stolen from Blackfire, and Kory awakens a new blue-light energy in return.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Tamaranean sibling arc and gives Kory a new power set.

beats.label: S3 · Donna returns
beats.text: Tim Drake, killed by Crane, meets Donna in the afterlife and crosses back with her — resurrecting Donna in Gotham as Rachel's Themyscira efforts fail.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brings Donna back and installs Tim as the new Robin in a single move.

beats.label: S3 · Rain and rot
beats.text: The Titans defeat Crane; Rachel uses the Lazarus Pit's rain to revive his victims, then secretly poisons Crane with its dark magic before the team heads home with Tim.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Gotham, sets the group's composition, and flags Rachel's darker turn.

cliffhanger.text: Gotham is saved and the Titans are heading back to San Francisco whole again, with Tim Drake as the new Robin. But Kory carries a new blue-light power she cannot fully control, and Rachel has just used the Lazarus Pit's darkness as a weapon.
questions: What has Rachel unleashed by cursing Crane with Lazarus magic?
Can Kory master the blue-light energy that now lives inside her?
How will Tim fit into a team he only just joined in the afterlife?

characters.name: Dick Grayson (Nightwing)
characters.line: Led the team through Gotham; briefly killed by Jason and revived in the Lazarus Pit, then reconciled with Barbara before leaving her behind.

characters.name: Kory Anders
characters.line: Lost her fire to Blackfire and awakened a new blue-light power she does not yet understand.

characters.name: Rachel Roth
characters.line: Returned from Themyscira; used the Lazarus Pit to resurrect victims and then to secretly curse Jonathan Crane.

characters.name: Garfield 'Gar' Logan
characters.line: Helped save Dick by turning into a bat and carrying him to the Lazarus Pit.

characters.name: Jason Todd
characters.line: Freed from Crane's fear drug; reconciled with Bruce and left Gotham to walk his own path.

characters.name: Tim Drake
characters.line: New Robin who died at Crane's hands and came back through the afterlife with Donna; travels with the Titans now.

characters.name: Donna Troy
characters.line: Resurrected in Gotham; recruited by A.R.G.U.S. and gone from the team.

characters.name: Conner
characters.line: Grew close to Blackfire and built her the ship she used to leave Earth.

characters.name: Blackfire (Komand'r)
characters.line: Took Kory's original powers, learned their parents had stolen them from her, and left Earth in Conner's ship.

beats.label: S4 · Luthor's heir
beats.text: Invited to S.T.A.R. Labs in Metropolis, Conner meets a dying Lex Luthor who names him heir to LexCorp — then Luthor dies as a magic serpent crawls from his body.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the season's setting, Conner's temptation, and the occult thread.

beats.label: S4 · Trigon cult
beats.text: Archaeologist May Bennett hunts a stranger named Sebastian Sanger, drains Rachel's powers with a magic staff, and reveals a Trigon cult that has been rebuilding for years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Bennett, Sanger, and the season's antagonist plan.

beats.label: S4 · Brother Blood
beats.text: Bennett's cult crowns Sanger as 'Brother Blood,' the child she rejected years ago; she manipulates him toward completing a ritual to resurrect Trigon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Sanger from victim into villain and names the ritual.

beats.label: S4 · Conner and Gar drift
beats.text: The serpent enters Conner and warps him toward Luthor's memory; Gar is pulled through dimensions by the Red and lands at Doom Manor, meeting Vic Stone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Isolates the two members whose absences dominate the second half.

beats.label: S4 · Abraxis
beats.text: Sanger burns Bennett to death, launches a game called Abraxis that feeds on its players' souls, and rises to power beside a corrupted Conner inside LexCorp.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sanger becomes his own villain, eclipsing his mother and the cult.

beats.label: S4 · Trigon consumed
beats.text: Sanger summons Trigon and immediately kills him, ripping out his heart to absorb his full power; he then kills Conner and turns on Kory to end Tamaran and Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's climactic reversal — Sanger swallows the original big bad.

beats.label: S4 · Kory ends it
beats.text: Conner is revived with red kryptonite, the team defeats Sanger, and Kory carries him into the sky and vaporises him before the Titans disband to their new lives.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the season, the villain, and the team itself.

cliffhanger.text: Sanger is dead and the Titans have chosen to go their separate ways: Gar back to the Red, Rachel to community college in Blüdhaven, Tim to guard both Metropolis and Gotham, and Conner to spend time with Superman — while Dick and Kory finally commit to being together.
questions: Will Gar embrace his new role as guardian of the Red?
Can Dick and Kory make a life together after everything?
Will the scattered Titans stay a family, or drift apart for good?

characters.name: Dick Grayson (Nightwing)
characters.line: Led the team through the cult arc and finally chose Kory as his partner.

characters.name: Kory Anders
characters.line: Killed Sanger to end him for good; now openly with Dick.

characters.name: Rachel Roth
characters.line: Lost her powers to Bennett and regained them; leaving the team for community college in Blüdhaven.

characters.name: Garfield 'Gar' Logan
characters.line: Confirmed as guardian of the Red; returns to that duty across dimensions.

characters.name: Tim Drake
characters.line: Fully stepped into Robin; staying east to protect Metropolis and Gotham together.

characters.name: Conner
characters.line: Possessed by Luthor's serpent, killed by Sanger, revived with red kryptonite; leaves to spend time with Superman.

characters.name: Sebastian Sanger (Brother Blood)
characters.line: Rejected at birth by the Trigon cult but later crowned Brother Blood; killed Trigon and was destroyed by Kory.

characters.name: May Bennett (Mother Mayhem)
characters.line: The cult's leader who groomed her own rejected son into Brother Blood; killed by him.

characters.name: Jinx
characters.line: A witch Dick recruited from prison; a wild-card ally through the cult arc.

characters.name: Lex Luthor
characters.line: Conner's genetic father, dead in the premiere but whose influence keeps warping Conner.
